name: redpanda-docs
description: Completion, hover, and build checks for Redpanda docs pages and data files.

redpandaDocs.serverPath.description: Path to bin/docs-language-server.js. Empty uses the copy of @redpanda-data/docs-extensions-and-macros installed in the workspace, so the editor runs the same version as the build.

redpandaDocs.docsPath.description: A local checkout of redpanda-data/docs, passed to the server as REDPANDA_DOCS_PATH. Cloud pages read their property data from it, and repositories without the taxonomy read taxonomy.yml from it.

redpandaDocs.componentPaths.description: Local checkouts of other docs components (for example cloud-docs or rp-connect-docs), for features that resolve references across components. Passed to the server at start.

redpandaDocs.standardsPath.description: A local checkout of redpanda-data/docs-team-standards, for features that read its templates or style rules. Passed to the server at start.
